qc.label_under_test: Weak, dense hum that is somewhat stronger on clinical-psychology / talking-therapy text (psychotherapy, psychiatric symptoms, counselling sessions, psychodynamic or interpersonal treatment, ECT), the + pole's topic leaking through; lateness ('too late') adds little or nothing over matched text. Speech therapy also bumps it (solver).

neighbours.label: Weak, dense hum (11% of tokens reach 0.1 of a small max) that rises on talk-based mental-health treatment: counselling and therapy sessions, psychiatrists, psychoanalysis, psychodynamic work, where people talk through their problems; speech therapy and the word 'talking' bump it a little. Symptom lists and CBT jargon, where the + pole takes over, stay near zero. Physical medicine (surgery, physio, pharmacy) hums at the 0.1-0.2 baseline. Lateness adds nothing: 'too late' scores like 'too early', and the feeders' foreign too/late/tan words (demasiado, zu spät, поздно) do not carry through, apart from a small bump on the headline 'Too Little too Late?'.
fire: Every Tuesday she sat with her counsellor and talked about the divorce.
The psychotherapist encouraged him to put his anger into words.
After the accident he started seeing a trauma therapist twice a month.
In psychoanalysis the patient lies on a couch and speaks freely.
Marriage counselling gave them a safe place to air old resentments.
Her psychiatrist spent the hour asking about her childhood and her moods.
Bereavement counselling helped the children talk about losing their mother.
Interpersonal therapy focuses on the patient's relationships and role changes.
quiet: Every Tuesday she sat with her physiotherapist and stretched her shoulder.
The orthopaedic surgeon set the broken bone in his wrist.
After the accident he started seeing a dentist twice a month.
The pharmacist counted out thirty tablets and labelled the bottle.
The ambulance crew got there too late to help the cyclist.
Llegaron demasiado tarde para salvar la cosecha.
The nurse took a blood sample and checked his temperature.
The cardiologist read the ECG and ordered a stress test.

predictions: 7-8/8 fire; at most 1 near miss at 0.30 (physiotherapy is the risk)
notes: Loop-back QC after mapping six feeders (L1/N1309-, L2/N10718+, L0/N6779+, L0/N6274+, L0/N1649-, L0/N8528+), several of them foreign 'too'/'late'/'tan' token detectors. Probes found they do not carry through to this pole: 'zu spät' 0.06, 'demasiado tarde' 0.18 vs 'muy temprano' 0.16, 'far too late' 0.15 vs 'too early' 0.13. Fresh sentences, not probed before pre-registration.
